g.text: NN = not null · UQ = unique · AI = auto increment

UQ* = part of the composite unique key (package_id, sort_order). View (not a table): team_users — read-only copy of users without password_hash, for the team account. Package prices are per hour (price) with a minimum number of hours (duration).
